name: Signals Intelligence (SIGINT)
title: Signals Intelligence Mastery Quiz
hubDescription: Assess SIGINT concepts, reporting quality, corroboration and responsible dissemination.
lede: Apply SIGINT concepts to fictional classroom exercises and information-review scenarios. Distinguish COMINT and ELINT, evaluate accuracy, timeliness and relevance, and reason through corroboration, security and the SIGINT cycle. {total} situational questions across Easy, Medium, and Hard. Practical interception, targeting, equipment operation and decryption procedures are not tested.
